newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: Content 1996 preliminary net up 22 pct.
newsitem.headline: Content 1996 preliminary net up 22 pct.

text.p: Dutch temporary employment firm Content said on Friday, its preliminary net profit rose by 22 percent in 1996 to 17.8 million guilders ($9.4 million).
The company added its operational profit increased by more than 30 percent from 1995, but did not give a precise figure.
The company did not give a forecast for the current year.
Content said it had mainly benefited from growth in the professional services sector, which accounts for 75 percent of its turnover.
"Turnover per (temporary employment) outlet increased," Content said in its statement.
In 1996, Content opened nine new temp offices. It said it intends to open an additional ten in 1997, from the current level of 78.
In 1996, Content also established Constructief, a joint venture with Dutch group SFB, focusing on temporary employment in the construction sector. It now has four outlets.
Content said its training division, Schoevers Opleidingen, strengthened its market share in the field of commercial training.
The turnover of Schoevers Opleidingen was unchanged from 1995, but the company opened additional offices.
Content said return on Schoevers was again good.
Content publishes its yearly figures on March 14.
